name: LED display installation
headline: LED display installation. Turnkey, on schedule.
subhead: From site survey, design and equipment supply to installation and handover. Indoor and outdoor, nationwide.
summary: Turnkey indoor and outdoor LED display installation with genuine equipment.
intro: A great LED screen starts with **the right survey and a proper installation**. SKV's engineers own the entire process, from steel frames and electrical cabinets to color calibration, so your display runs reliably for years.

benefits.title: Genuine equipment
benefits.text: Exclusive distributor of BOE MLED and authorized distributor of NovaStar in Vietnam. Officially imported, with full traceability.

benefits.title: Options for every budget
benefits.text: A wide range of product lines and price points, with a configuration matched to your actual needs.

benefits.title: Dedicated after-sales care
benefits.text: Fast technical support, on-site troubleshooting and long-term warranty under the manufacturer's policy.

process.title: Site survey
process.text: We measure the space, viewing distance, lighting conditions and power supply.

process.title: Consulting & design
process.text: A recommended configuration, structural drawings and a wiring plan.

process.title: Quotation & contract
process.text: A transparent, itemized quotation with a clear timeline.

process.title: Installation
process.text: Framing, electrical work, cabinet and module mounting, signal connection.

process.title: Calibration & handover
process.text: Color and brightness calibration, plus operator training.

process.title: Warranty & maintenance
process.text: Scheduled inspections and technical support for the life of the product.

name: Stage lighting installation
headline: Stage lighting installation. Light, exactly as intended.
subhead: Stage lighting systems designed and installed for events, weddings, bars, karaoke venues, auditoriums and theatres.
summary: Stage lighting design and installation at any scale.
intro: Lighting isn't just about being seen. It sets **the mood of the show**. SKV helps you choose the right fixtures, place them in the right positions and program the right cues for every space.

benefits.title: Always in stock
benefits.text: A wide range of fixture types, wattages and beam styles, delivered fast to meet your show date.

benefits.title: Tested before handover
benefits.text: Every fixture is thoroughly checked by our technicians before installation.

benefits.title: 24/7 support
benefits.text: Ready to advise and resolve technical issues whenever you need us.

process.title: Understand your needs
process.text: Type of show, stage size and the look you want.

process.title: Lighting design
process.text: Fixture layout, power calculations, rigging and control plan.

process.title: Equipment supply
process.text: Genuine moving heads, LED pars, profiles, lasers and special-effects equipment.

process.title: Installation & programming
process.text: Rigging fixtures, running DMX cabling and programming cues on the console.

process.title: Handover & training
process.text: A full test run, plus operation and maintenance training.

name: LED screen rental
headline: LED screen rental. Flexible for every event.
subhead: Daily, weekly, monthly or per-project packages, including transport, installation and an on-site operator.
summary: LED screens for hire by the day, week or project, with transport, setup and operation included.
intro: Not every event needs its own permanent screen. With SKV's rental service, you get **a high-quality LED screen in the right size, at the right time**, without worrying about transport, installation or operation.

benefits.title: Turnkey, on location
benefits.text: Transport, setup and dismantling in Hanoi and across the provinces.

benefits.title: On-site technicians
benefits.text: Operation and instant troubleshooting throughout your event.

benefits.title: Flexible sizing
benefits.text: Cabinets configured to fit your stage, flat or curved.

process.title: Define the purpose
process.text: Event type, content to be shown and audience size.

process.title: Assess the venue
process.text: Dimensions, mounting position and power supply on site.

process.title: Choose a configuration
process.text: Size, resolution, and ground-stacked or flown setup.

process.title: Setup & test run
process.text: We build the screen before the show and check content with the organizers.

process.title: Operation & teardown
process.text: A technician stays on duty throughout the event and removes the equipment afterwards.

name: LED display repair & maintenance
headline: LED display repair. The right fix, the right price, on time.
subhead: Maintenance, servicing and repair for indoor and outdoor LED displays of every brand, new or old.
summary: Diagnosis, repair and scheduled maintenance for LED displays of any brand.
intro: LED displays can last **100,000 hours** when properly cared for. SKV provides scheduled maintenance and repairs for displays of every brand, with genuine replacement parts and a warranty on all repairs.

benefits.title: Accurate diagnosis, fair pricing
benefits.text: A clear diagnosis, quotation and completion time before any work begins.

benefits.title: Genuine parts
benefits.text: Replacement modules, receiving cards, power supplies and processors from SKV's genuine parts inventory.

benefits.title: Warranty on repairs
benefits.text: Guaranteed warranty on replaced components and repair work.

issues: Dead pixels or dark patches on modules
Color mismatch between modules or cabinets
Faulty power supplies, receiving cards or sending cards

process.title: Report
process.text: Describe the issue by phone, via Zalo, or with photos and videos.

process.title: On-site inspection
process.text: A technician diagnoses the fault with specialized equipment.

process.title: Quotation
process.text: A clear explanation of the cause, solution, cost and timeline.

process.title: Repair
process.text: Component replacement, software updates and color recalibration.

process.title: Handover & warranty
process.text: Testing, handover and a warranty on the repair work.
